intent_types.name: OUTPUT_SET
intent_types.admission: OFF always admissible at domain boundary; ON requires no DDS start block, fail-safe authorization and SystemState OUTPUT_ON allowance

intent_types.name: WAVEFORM_SET
intent_types.admission: reject waveform handover FAULT or BUSY

intent_types.name: MODE_SET
intent_types.admission: reject waveform handover FAULT; BUSY may be accepted for queued scalar execution

intent_types.name: VSLEW_SETTING_SET
intent_types.admission: always accepted by Phase-0 policy boundary; no actuator ownership

intent_types.name: VSLEW_MODE_SET
intent_types.admission: always accepted by Phase-0 policy boundary; no actuator ownership
